name: Short Rest
description: At least one hour of downtime; characters may spend Hit Dice to recover HP.

name: Long Rest
description: At least eight hours, including at least six hours of sleep and no more than two hours of light activity; restores HP and up to half total Hit Dice (minimum one).

name: Hit Dice Recovery
description: During a short rest, spend Hit Dice, adding Constitution modifier to each roll (minimum 0 HP restored per die).
